foundationRepair.rootCause: apps/site and packages/radio-gaga-scene resolved different @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei peer instances because their @types/react peer graphs diverged. RadioGagaSceneContent then evaluated useThree against a Canvas context from the other Fiber instance, causing an uncaught Canvas-outside error and an unintended fallback chain.
foundationRepair.repair: Pin the root and RadioGaga @types/react constraints to 19.2.17 and regenerate the lockfile so site and RadioGaga resolve the identical Fiber, Drei, React, and React DOM module paths.
